_comment: RefractorForge Japanese UI (full coverage). Keys are the ENGLISH source strings; anything missing falls back to English. For labels carrying an ImGui ##id, translate ONLY the visible part - the editor re-appends the id. Edit freely and restart the editor - no rebuild needed. A user copy in %APPDATA%\RefractorForge\lang\ja.json overrides this file.
